label: PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_4: likelihood among observers after positive cell reweighting
definition: For a three-cell sampling row and positive weights r and t on its evidence and other-observer cells, the evidence-cell mass times r divided by the sum of both reweighted observer-cell masses. Unit weights give the existing observer-conditioned likelihood. Weights are not thereby calibrated counts or physical probabilities.
note: Analyst mathematical vocabulary for the plenitude controls (#2143); no source attribution or physical application is assumed.
